sloka: सुनिविष्टम् हितम् वाक्यम् उक्तवन्तम् विभीषणम् ।अब्रवीत् परुषम् वाक्यम् रावणः काल चोदितः ॥६-१६-१॥।।
transliteration: suniviṣṭam hitam vākyam uktavantam vibhīṣaṇam ।abravīt paruṣam vākyam rāvaṇaḥ kāla coditaḥ ॥6-16-1॥।।

translations.english: While Vibheeshana advised in Ravana's favour with all good intention, Ravana who was under the influence of death spoke harsh words.
